text:
Incident Bot: [ALERT] generation-api 5xx spike detected — 12% error rate over 5m, latency up for short requests. Pager sent to Alice (SRE). War room created: https://warroom.redwood.com/r/irq-7f3b

Alice (SRE): acked pager, joining war room now. I can take owner unless someone else closer to routing wants it.

Incident Bot: Paging log: pagerduty incident PD-9834 triggered -> Alice (SRE). Escalation policy: 5m -> oncall lead.

Raj (Platform Eng): thanks — assigning Alice as incident owner. tagging infra for kernel/driver noise check.

Alice (SRE): quick summary — symptoms: generation API returns HTTP 500 for ~12% of requests from the hosted tier, started ~1951232000, steady increase. Appears correlated with a recent deploy to replica pool g4dn-8xlarge-3.

Jess (Oncall): I'm in the war room. Observing similar errors on dedup service logs: `ERROR: shard timeout` repeated. Adding logs to war room slack link.

Alice (SRE): action plan: 1) rollback the last deploy on pool g4dn-8xlarge-3 (if safe), 2) scale pool by +20% to reduce pressure, 3) flip traffic to fallback model variant if rollback fails. Will run step 1 now.

Alice (SRE): running rollback:
```
# rollback last deploy
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/generation-api --to-revision=42
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/generation-api --replicas=24
```

Incident Bot: Deploy rollback started by Alice (SRE). CI job id: ci/7842.

Sam (Support): customer impact check: any customers currently getting errors on production? CX reported 3 support tickets in last 7m referencing timeouts on generation. I'll draft status page and customer blurb.

Maya (Product): customers with SLAs? A few enterprise customers on dedicated capacity — confirm dedicated unaffected?

Raj (Platform Eng): early indication: dedicated pools (dedicated-*) are unaffected. This looks confined to hosted pool g4dn-8xlarge-3 and its autoscaler.

Alice (SRE): rollback finished, health checks passing on 5/6 pods. Error rate dropping from 12% -> 3% over last 2 minutes. Keeping scaling command as precaution.

Jess (Oncall): confirming pager ack chain: Pager -> Alice -> Jess triage -> Raj infra. All present.

Sam (Support): status page draft (please copy/paste and edit):

"We are investigating an issue affecting the Redwood hosted generation API causing intermittent 500 errors and increased latencies. Some requests may fail or be retried. Our engineering team is actively investigating and has initiated a rollback of a recent deploy. We will post updates every 15 minutes or as our status changes."

Sam (Support): I'm going to post to status.redwood.com as "Investigating" and link the war room.

Maya (Product): suggested customer notification (short):
"We are aware of intermittent failures affecting text generation for hosted customers. Engineers are actively investigating; some requests may return errors. No action required from customers at this time. We'll provide updates in 15m."

Alice (SRE): agreed. Sam, please push the status page and tweet/internal comms. Also add incident owner + link to war room.

Incident Bot: Status page updated to "investigating" by Sam (Support). Status url: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/IR-2026-05-03-1

Jess (Oncall): ops note: if error rate doesn't drop below 1% in 10m, failover plan B is to remove pool g4dn-8xlarge-3 from the router and shift traffic to g4dn-4xlarge-* pools. That requires traffic config change: `routerctl set-weight pool=g4dn-8xlarge-3 weight=0`.

Alice (SRE): monitoring shows errors ~1.2% now. I'll keep an eye. If rates increase again I'll flip the traffic.

Sam (Support): posting customer-facing note now, linking status page and war room for enterprise contacts.

Jess (Oncall): quick doc for handoff in 10m: who is taking next watch? Alice can continue 10m then hand off to Raj if stable.

Alice (SRE): plan: hold for 10 minutes after error rate <1% sustained, then handoff to Raj for 2hr watch. I'll add handoff note in this thread when I leave.

(9 minutes pass)

Alice (SRE): 10:05 UTC — error rate steady ~0.9% for 8m. Starting handoff to Raj. Handoff checklist: symptom summary, rollback done, scaling applied, status page updated, war room link.

Raj (Platform Eng): taking over. Acked handoff. I'll be primary on-call owner for the next 2 hours. If we see regression, page Alice and oncall lead.

Jess (Oncall): confirming handoff, leaving war room for normal ops. Please ping in thread for any regressions. :thumbsup:

Sam (Support): updated internal comms template in war room, added suggested text for account managers to reach out to enterprise customers if they request updates.

Incident Bot: Pager duty note: PD-9834 status -> acknowledged -> owner: Raj (Platform Eng).

Raj (Platform Eng): I'll run follow-up checks: tail `generation-api` logs for `500` and check autoscaler events. If anything pops within the next 30m I'll escalate.

Alice (SRE): leaving the war room but available if needed. Good job team — short postmortem and timeline will be filed after stable.

Sam (Support): status page will move to "identified" after 30m of stability, then "resolved" once metrics are back to baseline.

Maya (Product): thanks all. Useful notes for the post-incident comms: impact, rollback, mitigations, next steps, and customer outreach plan.

(End of thread)
